responsibility: Declares support routines used by dead store elimination and related memory optimizers. It defines the dse_store_status classification enum and exports helpers to classify a store’s liveness against later memory effects and to delete dead or redundant assignments while coordinating optional CFG cleanup bitmaps.
same_name_distinction: This header provides the support API around dead-store analysis, such as the dse_store_status enum and helper declarations for classifying or deleting stores. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-dse.cc, it does not implement the DSE pass or perform the reverse memory-def walk.
